body:
Remediates a high-severity SSRF vulnerability (CWE-918) in the HTTP source implementation. 

- Implemented `SSRFGuard` to prevent DNS rebinding (TOCTOU) attacks.
- Added `allowPrivateNetworks`, `allowedIpRanges`, and `customBlockedIpRanges` properties to configure boundary safety.
- Implemented early fast-fail validation on the configured `BaseURL` at initialization time.
- Emits an explicit warning detail highlighting the Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) risk when `disableSslVerification` is enabled.

Reported by: Syed Anas Mohiuddin
title: fix(source/http): implement SSRF guard
